label: High Availability Pro
summary: Advanced service-continuity coordination, failover rehearsals, leader/fence evidence and rolling-maintenance workflows on already admitted nodes/providers. Availability is scoped to qualified topology/workload/failure cases; node enrollment and placement orchestration belong to Multi-server Hosting Pro, while application releases remain deployment workflows.
core_boundary: Core remains a complete standalone panel with essential recovery, ordinary service lifecycle and open-source node/provider authority when implemented. This module adds optional cross-node continuity coordination; it creates neither a second node registry nor an unreviewed remote root/cluster-control path.
acceptance: Admit topology and peer identities explicitly, including network partitions, quorum/fencing and shared-storage assumptions.
Test split-brain, stale leaders, delayed messages and asymmetric failures before enabling a promotion strategy.
Measure actual service continuity and recovery for each supported workload rather than promising generic zero downtime.
Keep current authorization, resource revisions and audit consistent across every admitted node operation.
Document safe module exit and independent recovery without disabling existing hosted services.
